common.title: Title
common.deletePlaylistConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the playlist "{plName}"?

about.title: About
about.autoUpdatesDesc: If disabled, prevents the app from checking for updates in the background.
about.languageDesc: Change the language displayed in the interface.
about.notifySlowOpen: Notify if opening takes too long
about.notifySlowOpenDesc: Diagnose app issues by seeing what causes it to load slowly.
about.license: Distributed under the GNU GPLv3 License.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.baseThemeDesc: Select the base mode. The custom colors below will apply specifically to the selected mode.
appearance.builtInSchemesDesc: Select a scheme to automatically override your colors with palettes based on native environments.
appearance.themeManagementDesc: Save your custom color palette to a JSON file or load a previously created theme.
appearance.invalidThemeFile: The file does not have a valid Soundgaze theme format.
appearance.readError: There was an error reading the file. Make sure it is a valid JSON.
appearance.exportError: An error occurred while exporting the theme.

libraryData.subtitle: Manage your file paths, indexing, and the appearance of your lists.
libraryData.pathDesc: Main folder where you keep your music. Covers will be searched based on this path.
libraryData.scanDesc: Force MPD to look for new audio files, folders, or changes in tags (Metadata).
libraryData.cacheDesc: Empties the temporary memory of album covers. Useful if you just embedded new images in your MP3s and they are not reflecting.
libraryData.columnsDesc: Customize what information you want to see in playlists and the library. Title and artist will always be visible.

playback.title: Playback
playback.subtitle: Adjust how the audio engine behaves and transitions.
playback.crossfadeDesc: Overlaps the end of the current song with the beginning of the next one to eliminate silences.
playback.normalizeDesc: Automatically adjusts songs to play at the same level, preventing some from being too loud and others too quiet.
playback.resumeDesc: Continues playing the last song at the exact point where you left off when opening the application.
playback.outputDesc: Select where you want the sound to be played.

daemon.title: Daemon Connection (MPD)
daemon.subtitle: Configure network parameters to communicate with the MPD server.
daemon.hostDesc2: if the daemon is running on this same computer.
daemon.passwordDesc: Only required if you configured authentication in your mpd.conf file.

system.title: System Behavior
system.subtitle: Adjust how the application interacts with the operating system.
system.minimizeToTrayDesc: When clicking the "X", the application will continue playing music in the background from the taskbar.
system.dangerZoneDesc: This will erase all your settings, library cache, and player state.
system.factoryResetConfirm: Are you sure you want to factory reset Soundgaze? You will lose your configurations, favorites, and the app will restart.
system.factoryResetError: There was an error trying to clear the data.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Soundgaze
onboarding.subtitle: Your music library, reimagined.
onboarding.step1Desc1: Soundgaze is a beautiful client, but it doesn't play music on its own. You need to have
onboarding.step1Desc2: installed and running on your computer (or a remote server).
onboarding.step2Desc1: By default, we will try to connect to
onboarding.step2Desc2: . If your MPD has a password or is on another IP, you can change it in the player's Settings tab.
onboarding.step3Desc2: . Once connected, go to Settings and press "Scan Library" so Soundgaze can download all your covers and index your catalog.

plugins.title: Plugins & Extensions
plugins.subtitle: Enable additional features for the player. Disabled plugins do not consume memory or resources.
plugins.largeArtDesc: Allows clicking the cover art on the playback bar to view the album art in an immersive, blurred modal.
plugins.bgTypeDesc: Choose how the background behind the cover is rendered.
plugins.blurDesc: Applies an extreme blur to the background image.
plugins.animDesc: Slow zoom effect while music is playing.
plugins.themeDesc: Adapts text colors based on the cover's brightness.

graphView.title: Graphical View
graphView.instructions: Click a node to expand it or drag to explore.
graphView.graphicalViewDesc: Explore your library as an interactive network of nodes with real-time physics.
graphView.showAlbumCoversDesc: Draws the album image directly on the circular node. Turning this off improves performance for very large libraries.

lyrics.lyricsDesc: Displays synchronized lyrics on the right side when Full-Screen Artwork is active.

timelineView.title: Musical Timeline
timelineView.desc: Group and explore all your albums chronologically sorted by release year.
timelineView.noAlbumsFound: No albums found in this year.
